summary_en: 1,100,000 shares (8.63% of shares outstanding), ¥1.5B upper limit. Acquisition period 7 Aug 2026 to 31 Dec 2026. Method: open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Stated reason: shareholder return and capital-efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: MarkLines Co., Ltd. announced on 6 August 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire up to 1,100,000 treasury shares (8.63% of the 12,746,513 shares outstanding, ex-treasury, as of 30 June 2026) for a maximum aggregate purchase price of ¥1.5 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 7 August and 31 December 2026. The board stated that the acquisition is intended to optimize shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency in light of the company's stock price trends and financial position.
